label: TP
reason: Single alert java/xss verified as TP. Data flow: user input from request.getParameter() -> param variable -> bar after partial quote escaping -> direct insertion into HTML attribute (data-name). Resolved sink value remains attacker-controlled since sanitize only escapes double quotes, leaving < > & unescaped. Attacker can inject <script> tags that execute despite partial mitigation.

evidence.note: User input flows through param to bar, then printed unsafely into HTML attribute with incomplete sanitization
